approvals.title: Reality Was Never Hidden
approvals.feedback: The approved revision replaced unrelated early-to-middle stock footage with literal animated metaphors. Direct narrative correspondence must outrank atmosphere, aesthetic similarity, or a broad semantic association. Preserve strong exact-match documentary footage and the final act when it clearly represents the spoken line.
